id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Come on, everyone! Get moving! Leave the swordplay to the men! This is our battlefield!!
"There you are! Amber! Big news! Big news!!
"Hee hee, don't be shocked, Amber. Look over there.
"{var:1}, thank goodness you're safe. Such terrible things have happened... I was sure you... Oh...
"Many died in that explosion. Then the mornings stopped, and dreadful monsters flooded the continent.
"Even the survivors slowly lost the will to live...
"Then he appeared before us. Regardless of rank or nation, he helped everyone in trouble.
"He protected us from monsters and brought us to this village. Without him, who knows what would have become of us...
"Now this village is called the Last Bastion, and people from all over the continent gather here.
"...And what's more, the King of Heliodor is here too!
"Now, now, don't make that face. You can't forget the village being burned. But holding a grudge won't help.
"I won't say do it right away, but you should go see the King. Your grandfather would have said so."
